ideas.pitch: A high-performance log parsing engine utilizing memory-mapped files and SIMD instructions to process massive log datasets orders of magnitude faster than the naive reference implementation.
ideas.problem_statement: Log processing track: Process massive logs correctly and efficiently within strict CPU and memory bounds.
ideas.title: ZeroCopyLogParser
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the machine-measured performance score directly by avoiding garbage collection and minimizing syscall overhead in Rust.

ideas.pitch: A blazing-fast search indexing solution using succinct data structures, Roaring Bitmaps, and variable-byte compression to satisfy query specs with minimal peak memory.
ideas.problem_statement: Search indexing track: Build an efficient index that matches the reference output byte for byte under tight resource limits.
ideas.title: BitPackedInvertedIndex
ideas.why_it_could_win: Optimizes memory layout and search algorithms, which directly maximizes the efficiency coefficient scored by automated benchmarks.

ideas.pitch: A streaming CSV parser and join engine using custom arena allocators and zero-allocation string slicing to parse and merge complex tabular data efficiently.
ideas.problem_statement: Complex CSV parsing and joining track: Parse and join large CSV datasets correctly and rapidly.
ideas.title: StreamJoinCSV
ideas.why_it_could_win: Beats standard language CSV parsers by bypassing heavy runtime overhead and custom-building stream parsers.

ideas.pitch: A cache-conscious graph routing engine implementing bidirectional Dijkstra and parallelized shortest-path algorithms with flat array representations.
ideas.problem_statement: Graph algorithms track: Execute complex shortest-path graph calculations efficiently on a dedicated benchmarking machine.
ideas.title: CacheAlignedPathfinder
ideas.why_it_could_win: Exploits CPU cache locality and graph compaction techniques to drastically reduce execution time relative to the naive reference implementation.

ideas.pitch: A high-throughput lossless compression and decompression engine leveraging optimized ANS (Asymmetric Numeral Systems) and custom bit-streams.
ideas.problem_statement: Lossless compression track: Compress and decompress data accurately within tight CPU and memory limits.
ideas.title: EntropyStreamCodec
ideas.why_it_could_win: Balances compression ratio and execution speed carefully to maximize the published efficiency coefficient.
